stories.title: ‘It’s definitely a blessing’ | Thousands of Harris County families receive free turkeys ahead of Thanksgiving
stories.summary: The American Farm Bureau Federation said that the average cost of a Thanksgiving turkey increased 10% compared to 2025.

stories.title: All-clear issued after fire at ExxonMobil Baytown Olefins Plant
stories.summary: No injuries were reported. Baytown and Sheldon fire crews responded as a precaution, according to a city spokesperson.

stories.title: Body found in abandoned downtown Houston hotel renews safety concerns
stories.summary: Neighbors say the former Holiday Inn poses ongoing safety problems. Houston Public Works says it is monitoring the property and evaluating next steps.

stories.title: Houston police lieutenant relieved of duty as internal affairs investigates
stories.summary: The department confirmed the action but did not disclose what prompted the internal affairs investigation.

stories.title: Father who helped family escape burning Houston Heights townhome dies from injuries
stories.summary: A father who suffered severe burns while helping his family escape a burning Heights townhome has died, according to the Buzbee Law Firm.

stories.title: Eisenhower Park reopens after more than two years, nearly $3.8 million in repairs
stories.summary: The popular northeast Harris County park was devastated by flooding in 2024 and later hit by Hurricane Beryl. Now, visitors are finally getting their park back.

stories.title: HPD: Juveniles find man's body inside abandoned downtown Houston building
stories.summary: Investigators say the juveniles were trespassing in the building when they found the man's body in water that had collected in an elevator area.

stories.title: His sister spent decades searching for answers. She learned he was found just before her death
stories.summary: John Richard Moulis' sister learned he had been identified just two days before her death.

stories.title: Vehicle crashes into northwest Harris County home, deputies say
stories.summary: Precinct 4 deputies and emergency crews are investigating the crash on Broken Sky Drive. People are asked to avoid the immediate area.

stories.title: Multiple hurt after chain-reaction crash caused bus to slam into pillar, Houston METRO says
stories.summary: The bus driver, as well as five passengers and the drivers of the other two vehicles, were taken to area hospitals. Everyone involved is expected to survive.

stories.title: Texas power grid CEO secures multimillion-dollar contract extension, angering Dan Patrick
stories.summary: The ERCOT CEO’s extension deal was on hold for months after the lieutenant governor criticized the payouts. It was finalized weeks after Patrick lost reelection.

stories.title: 2-year-old flown to hospital after car sped through multiple red lights, slammed into truck, HCSO says
stories.summary: Everyone involved in the crash was taken to area hospitals and is expected to be OK.
